package net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspsupport;

import java.lang.reflect.Field;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationHandler;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import net.runelite.client.config.Config;
import net.runelite.client.config.ConfigManager;
import net.runelite.client.config.ConfigDescriptor;
import net.runelite.client.config.ConfigProfile;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.api.GameState;
import net.runelite.api.Player;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.Microbot;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.breakhandler.BreakHandlerScript;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.combat.Rs2Combat;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.player.Rs2Player;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.security.LoginManager;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.walker.Rs2Walker;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.widget.Rs2Widget;
import org.mockito.MockedStatic;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

/** Copy to .java outside the repository when compiling; Source Loader must not load Mockito. */
public final class KspBreakServiceTest
{
    static void check(boolean condition, String message) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message); }
    static void set(Object target, String name, Object value) throws Exception {
        Field field = KspBreakService.class.getDeclaredField(name); field.setAccessible(true); field.set(target, value);
    }
    static Object get(Object target, String name) throws Exception {
        Field field = KspBreakService.class.getDeclaredField(name); field.setAccessible(true); return field.get(target);
    }
    static void tick(KspBreakService target, long time) throws Exception {
        Method method = KspBreakService.class.getDeclaredMethod("tick", long.class); method.setAccessible(true); method.invoke(target, time);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
    {
        ConfigManager manager = mock(ConfigManager.class, CALLS_REAL_METHODS);
        Set<String> groups = new HashSet<>();
        for (String name : args)
        {
            Class<?> type = Class.forName(name);
            Config instance = (Config) Proxy.newProxyInstance(type.getClassLoader(), new Class<?>[]{type},
                    (proxy, method, arguments) -> InvocationHandler.invokeDefault(proxy, method, arguments));
            ConfigDescriptor descriptor = manager.getConfigDescriptor(instance);
            check(groups.add(descriptor.getGroup().value()), "separate plugin config group: " + name);
            check(descriptor.getSections().stream().anyMatch(section -> section.getKey().equals("breakHandler")), "visible Break Handler section: " + name);
            check(descriptor.getItems().stream().filter(item -> item.getItem().section().equals("breakHandler")).count() == 5, "five inherited break settings: " + name);
            check(((KspBreakConfig) instance).breakAfterMinMinutes() == 45, "default config value: " + name);
        }
        check(args.length == 22, "all 22 automation config panels validated");
        KspBreakConfig config = new KspBreakConfig() {};
        check(config.doBreaks() && config.breakAfterMinMinutes() == 45 && config.breakAfterMaxMinutes() == 90
                && config.breakDurationMinMinutes() == 5 && config.breakDurationMaxMinutes() == 15, "Account Builder defaults");
        check(KspBreakService.randomMinutes(15, 5, 1, 180) >= TimeUnit.MINUTES.toMillis(5), "reversed range");
        check(KspBreakService.randomMinutes(-20, -1, 1, 180) == 60_000, "invalid lower limit");
        check(KspBreakService.randomMinutes(400, 400, 1, 180) == TimeUnit.MINUTES.toMillis(180), "invalid upper limit");
        try (MockedStatic<Microbot> microbot = mockStatic(Microbot.class);
             MockedStatic<Rs2Combat> combat = mockStatic(Rs2Combat.class);
             MockedStatic<Rs2Player> player = mockStatic(Rs2Player.class);
             MockedStatic<LoginManager> login = mockStatic(LoginManager.class);
             MockedStatic<Rs2Walker> walker = mockStatic(Rs2Walker.class);
             MockedStatic<Rs2Widget> widget = mockStatic(Rs2Widget.class);
             MockedStatic<BreakHandlerScript> shared = mockStatic(BreakHandlerScript.class))
        {
            Client client = mock(Client.class);
            microbot.when(Microbot::getClient).thenReturn(client);
            when(client.getWorld()).thenReturn(301);
            when(client.getGameState()).thenReturn(GameState.LOGGED_IN);
            when(client.getLocalPlayer()).thenReturn(mock(Player.class));
            microbot.when(Microbot::isLoggedIn).thenReturn(true);
            KspBreakService service = new KspBreakService();
            set(service, "config", config); set(service, "enabled", true);
            set(service, "nextBreakAt", 100_000L); set(service, "lastTick", 99_500L);
            Microbot.pauseAllScripts.set(true);
            tick(service, 100_000);
            check(!(boolean)get(service,"pauseOwned"), "do not claim someone else's pause");
            check((long)get(service,"nextBreakAt") == 100_500, "freeze play timer during external pause");
            service.shutdown();
            check(Microbot.pauseAllScripts.get(), "shutdown must preserve external pause");
            set(service,"config",config); set(service,"enabled",true);
            Microbot.pauseAllScripts.set(false);
            combat.when(Rs2Combat::inCombat).thenReturn(true);
            tick(service, 101_000);
            check(Microbot.pauseAllScripts.get(), "claim pause before logout");
            player.verify(Rs2Player::logout, never());
            combat.when(Rs2Combat::inCombat).thenReturn(false);
            tick(service, 111_999);
            player.verify(Rs2Player::logout, never());
            tick(service, 112_000);
            player.verify(Rs2Player::logout, times(1));
            tick(service, 112_500);
            player.verify(Rs2Player::logout, times(1));
            tick(service, 115_000);
            player.verify(Rs2Player::logout, times(2)); // retry a failed logout, with a cooldown
            microbot.when(Microbot::isLoggedIn).thenReturn(false);
            tick(service, 116_000);
            long end = (long)get(service,"breakEndsAt");
            check(end >= 116_000 + TimeUnit.MINUTES.toMillis(5), "full offline duration starts after logout");
            tick(service, end - 1);
            login.verifyNoInteractions();
            when(client.getGameState()).thenReturn(GameState.LOGIN_SCREEN);
            tick(service, end);
            check(Microbot.pauseAllScripts.get(), "stay paused if login profile is missing");
            when(client.getGameState()).thenReturn(GameState.LOGIN_SCREEN);
            login.when(LoginManager::getActiveProfile).thenReturn(mock(ConfigProfile.class));
            tick(service, end + 100);
            login.verify(() -> LoginManager.login(301), times(1));
            tick(service, end + 400);
            login.verify(() -> LoginManager.login(301), times(1));
            widget.when(() -> Rs2Widget.isWidgetVisible(net.runelite.api.gameval.InterfaceID.WelcomeScreen.PLAY)).thenReturn(true);
            tick(service, end + 3_100);
            widget.verify(() -> Rs2Widget.clickWidget(net.runelite.api.gameval.InterfaceID.WelcomeScreen.PLAY), times(1));
            check(Microbot.pauseAllScripts.get(), "welcome screen still paused");
            widget.when(() -> Rs2Widget.isWidgetVisible(net.runelite.api.gameval.InterfaceID.WelcomeScreen.PLAY)).thenReturn(false);
            when(client.getGameState()).thenReturn(GameState.LOGGED_IN);
            microbot.when(Microbot::isLoggedIn).thenReturn(true);
            tick(service, end + 3_500);
            check(!Microbot.pauseAllScripts.get(), "resume only after game scene is ready");
            check((long)get(service,"nextBreakAt") > end + 500, "schedule next play interval");
            set(service,"nextBreakAt",end + 4_000);
            tick(service,end + 4_000);
            check(Microbot.pauseAllScripts.get(),"second break acquired");
            service.shutdown();
            check(!Microbot.pauseAllScripts.get(),"stop releases owned pause");
        }
        System.out.println("PASS: 22 config descriptors, defaults, range normalization, external pause ownership, combat grace, logout retries, offline duration, missing profile, preserved world, login throttling, welcome screen, resume and shutdown");
    }
}
